ScenarioDef.label: Eastern Zhou: The Royal Court Moves East
ScenarioDef.description: A small Zheng-region village begins in 770 BCE as the Zhou court moves east. Historical RimWorld chronology is a prototype, and the world map is not a reconstruction of ancient China.

scenario.name: Eastern Zhou: The Royal Court Moves East
scenario.summary: Five generated villagers begin a local community under Zheng allegiance in 770 BCE. Survive, build a family history, and continue beyond the chapter end if you wish.
